function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT
  SUM(pl.qty * pl.unit_price_orig * (pl.fx_rate - aug_avg.fx_rate)) AS fx_effect_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD'
    AND period = '2026-08'
) aug_avg
WHERE pl.currency = 'USD'
  AND pl.period = '2026-09'","purpose":"Compute FX effect on CAD cost for USD purchase lines in Sep vs Aug using average Aug fx rate"}
